fan_withdrawal.scope: Continuous rectangular swept envelope ofØ900×180 fan reservation. Requires near half-shell, rail span and discharge-arm removal. Supplier brackets, tool/rigging space, wires/hoses and weight/CG not available; no approved handling method.

airflow.air_sealing_status: Floor support cutouts, core edges, removable joints and service openings require sealed interfaces and leakage testing; nominal CAD does not establish airtightness.

thermal_example.formula: T_out=T_in+Q/(rho*cp*Vdot). The same air passes each stage; no summation of independent fan CFM demands. All core ratings must use their own preheated inlet temperature.
thermal_example.power_formula: Pdrive=Vdot*deltaP/overall_efficiency. Pressure and efficiency examples only; not selected duty points.

controls: One fan command responds to the highest cooling demand across coolant, charge-air, hydraulic oil and bay temperature. Setpoints, drive, RPM monitoring, fault response and OEM derate remain open. No second cooling or ventilation fan specified.
release_holds: Configured engine, CAC, hydraulic and surface/exhaust-to-bay heat duties
Core order, actual inlet-temperature capability and pressure curves
Single fan installed duty point, drive power, dimensions and supplier mounts
Frame/support reactions, wet mass, cantilever/vibration and structural approval
Inlet protection, sealed floor penetrations, drainage and screen pressure drop
Discharge turning losses, louver free area and external recirculation
Actual fan removal/handling, core cleaning and service access
Stationary hot-weather full-load verification with all service panels closed
source_scope: General enclosure/radiator ventilation integration only; not Kubota installation approval.
